about.name: Kevin Sultana Herman
about.bio: I build end-to-end web products with a focus on performance, clean architecture, and clear user experience. My experience includes Reachable Goods for e-commerce with Midtrans integration, the Nutritional Program Foundation for operational management systems, and freelance work for a travel CRM and a US construction company website.

description: Built a web-based IT Service Management (ITSM) platform for PLN covering Incident, Service Request, and Change workflows aligned with ITIL practices.
Developed responsive dashboards (SLA compliance, ticket backlog) and implemented robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with secure data isolation.
Improved performance and UX with reusable UI components, input debouncing, and pagination/virtualization.
Built a cross-platform React Native app to digitize warehouse operations including picking, packing, and cycle counting.
Implemented Barcode/QR scanning and integrated thermal printing (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi) using ESC/POS and ZPL/CPCL commands for packing labels.
Optimized UX and performance on low-end devices using FlatList virtualization and memoization, alongside REST API integrations.
Created responsive travel websites with booking features using React, Tailwind CSS, and third-party APIs.
Optimized page loading speed and SEO performance for better visibility.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A curated selection of polished projects that show how I turn ideas into clear, useful, production-ready web experiences.

projects.name: SnapBill (SaaS Invoicing & Billing Automation)
projects.description: End-to-end SaaS invoicing and billing automation platform engineered to handle dynamic client billing, tax/discount calculation, automated multi-channel payment reconciliation via Midtrans, secure PDF storage on MinIO, and scheduled cron jobs for overdue reminders.
projects.impact: End-to-end invoice lifecycle automation with real-time Midtrans payment reconciliation, MinIO PDF archiving, and scheduled cron alerts.

projects.name: ITSM (PLN BAg)
projects.description: A Next.js frontend for an IT Service Management system with Helpdesk and Home portals, ticket workflows, Change Request approvals, reporting, agent management, and SLA configuration.
projects.impact: Automated ITIL ticketing and Change Request workflows with real-time SLA deadline monitoring.

projects.name: Hearts2 Mobile (Hino Motors)
projects.description: A cross-platform mobile application built with React Native, featuring separate Android and iOS codebases and UI libraries such as React Native Paper and React Navigation.
projects.impact: Optimized cross-platform Android & iOS rendering performance with modular components and isolated navigation.

projects.name: MBG SPPG
projects.description: An integrated ERP platform built with Next.js, Node.js, and Prisma to streamline meal deliveries, attendance, payroll, warehouse stock, and financial tracking.
projects.impact: Centralized end-to-end operations: inventory tracking, attendance, payroll, and meal dispatch.

projects.name: Reachable Goods
projects.description: A fast e-commerce platform built with Next.js and React, powered by a Node.js and Prisma backend, and integrated with Midtrans for payments and Minio for scalable object storage.
projects.impact: Seamless Midtrans payment gateway and MinIO object storage integration with ACID transactional safety.

projects.name: Superlife Bio Indonesia
projects.description: A modern company profile and landing page built with React and Vite, designed to present products, company history, achievements, and global presence with clarity.
projects.impact: Sub-second initial page load powered by Vite bundling and responsive multi-viewport showcase.

projects.name: Point Juaro (E-commerce)
projects.description: A final project built with Next.js, focused on modern frontend structure and code quality through PostCSS and ESLint configurations.
projects.impact: Modular frontend architecture built to industry standards with cross-component testing and strict linting.
